Name: Shannon Bicksler
Badge: Everyday Sparks
Which strategy from this module (Writer’s Notebook, Quicklists, or Writing Sprints) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

I think the Quick lists and writing sprints feel most immediately usable. I think it is a quick activity that could summarize a topic or just as a way to let students write without it having to be subject specific. I feel that is easier to implement compared to the writers notebook at this point in the year. Although I do think I plan on implementing some kind of notebook next year and these can be a part of it.

What do you anticipate will be the biggest challenge in bringing daily writing into your classroom, and how might you address it?:

I think the biggest challenge will be students not wanting to do it or not fully buying into it. I hope that if they continue to do it and see that they have a choice in what they write about then they might enjoy it more. I am also hoping that it could help with writing for short answer questions on tests and the EOC because in the writing prompts they have to write more than 1 sentence since they are supposed to write for at least 3 minutes and it might help them be able to explain the concepts in writing.

How often do you see yourself using a routine writing practice with students?:
Daily
2-3 times per week
